entities.summary: Claude Jorda is a French jurist and former Judge at the International Criminal Court (2003–2007). He resigned "for reasons of permanent ill-health". Previously, he had been a Judge at the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia (ICTY) since January 1994.
